items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: He tried to copy off Big Spiderback, you know what I mean?

ctx.x: Poor Emmett didn't last for one. He wasn't going. Like Charlie? Same way, he just had good rhythm. Sorta like that. He had a Grodin style though, wasn't it? That's all. That's all.
It wasn't a Big Spiderback style, was it? No, Big Spiderback, no.
None of that was... He tried to copy off Big Spiderback, you know what I mean? That's what you tried to do. You never used to like that, remember you? Still do. Used to like that.
